name: portabile-tmp-dirs
title: 跨平台临时目录：去掉硬编码 /tmp 路径（票 5as）
description: 全量门禁里唯一确定性的本地失败来自硬编码 /tmp：上传图片写 /tmp/xhs_images、封面生成写 /tmp/xhs_generated_covers，Windows 下解析成盘符根目录并可能不可写。改用 tempfile.gettempdir()，Linux/容器行为不变；加静态回归测试禁止 backend 再出现 /tmp/ 字面量。
creator: codex
notes: FIXED 2026-10-31. Portability bug surfaced by the local CI rehearsal: the full suite's only deterministic failure was test_upload_images_updates_previous_node_without_advancing_review_gate, because the image-upload handler wrote to Path("/tmp/xhs_images/{thread_id}") -- on Windows that resolves to the current drive root (\tmp\...) and can be unwritable (Errno 13 in this sandbox). publisher.py had the same pattern for generated covers (/tmp/xhs_generated_covers). Both now derive from Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) with the same subdirectory names, so Linux/container behaviour is unchanged (gettempdir() is /tmp there; TMPDIR override is standard). Guard: tests/unit/test_no_hardcoded_tmp_paths.py scans backend/**/*.py ASTs for string constants equal to or starting with /tmp (docstrings/comments exempt) and pins the previously-red integration test's cause; mutation check (reverting one path to /tmp) turns the scan red. Verification: the integration test that failed is now green on Windows; related set 62 passed (1 test_text_cover sandbox tmp_path ERROR is environmental); ruff check + format green.
